title: SuperAdmin Platform Settings 10/10 Overhaul & Google Cloud-Inspired Control Center (SWOT Optimization, Dual-Tier Multi-Tenant Fallback & Cuba M3 Navigation Tree)
spec:
# DIR-015: SuperAdmin Platform Settings 10/10 Overhaul & Google Cloud-Inspired Control Center

## 1. Executive Context & Root-Cause Analysis
When the platform was migrated to Cuba Executive Design System (`AdminPortalCuba.jsx` using `CubaPortalShell`), the legacy `Sidebar.jsx` (which contained the 6 accordion groups and 30 settings links shown in the screenshot) was unmounted (`{!isCubaChrome && <Sidebar />}`).
The Cuba navigation configuration (`src/components/cuba/portalNavigation.js`) only exposed a single bare route `{ id: 'admin-settings', label: 'System Settings', to: '/admin/settings', permission: '*' }`.
Because `Settings.jsx` had no internal navigation drawer/rail or tab bar (it previously relied entirely on the legacy sidebar to set `?tab=...`), unmounting the legacy sidebar rendered 29 of the 30 settings completely unreachable from the UI, giving the impression that they were removed.

This directive mandates a complete 10/10 architectural overhaul of `Settings.jsx` into a Google Cloud Console / Google Workspace Admin-inspired Control Center with an integrated navigation tree, omnibox search, Google M3 design tokens, dual-tier multi-tenant fallback indicators, and dedicated Playwright E2E verification.

## 2. SWOT & Structural Categorization (30 Settings across 6 Groups)
1. **Modules & Addons**:
   - `modulesSettings` (Addon Modules): Master kill-switches for platform modules (Job Board, AI Resume Builder, Cover Letter, Portfolios, AI Interview Coach, Employer Portal, Enterprise Portal).
2. **General & Branding**:
   - `websiteSettings` (Brand Identity & Meta): Site title, description, canonical domain, OpenGraph SEO tags.
   - `brandingSettings` (Branding & Assets): Platform logos, favicons, watermarks (Global Fallback for tenant white-labeling).
   - `geoSeoSettings` (Indian Geo-SEO): India regional targeting tags (geo.region: IN), city targeting, schema.org job markup.
   - `llmGeoSettings` (LLM GEO / AI Search): llms.txt, Perplexity/ChatGPT crawler indexes, markdown search summaries.
   - `firebaseSettings` (Firebase Identity): Firebase Auth API keys, project ID, OAuth domain credentials (SuperAdmin only).
   - `databaseSettings` (Database & Persistence Engine): MariaDB pools, migrations, background sync worker, dual-DB sync (SuperAdmin only).
   - `socialAuthSettings` (Social Sign-On & OAuth): Google, LinkedIn, GitHub OAuth client IDs/secrets (SuperAdmin only).
   - `emailSettings` (Email & SMTP): Default transactional SMTP gateway & templates (Global Fallback for tenant custom SMTP).
3. **AI Engine & Services**:
   - `storageSettings` (Cloud Storage): AWS S3 / Cloudinary credentials (Global Fallback for tenant BYOS).
   - `aiSettings` (AI & Gemini / NIM Providers): Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter (Global Fallback for tenant BYOK).
   - `exportPdfSettings` (PDF Exporter): Puppeteer render cluster, timeouts, print formats.
   - `jobScraperSettings` (Job & Naukri Scraper): Automated job scraping and syndication feeds.
   - `twilioSmsSettings` (Twilio SMS Gateway): Global SMS/OTP delivery gateway (Global Fallback).
4. **Payments & Gateways**:
   - `currencySettings` (Platform Currency): Base settlement currency (INR ₹ standard), ISO-4217, exchange rate sync.
   - `ordersManagement` (Orders & Transactions): Master invoice ledger, payment reconciliation.
   - `subscriptionsSettings` (Subscriptions & Gateways): Razorpay, Stripe credentials, plan pricing tiers.
   - `watermarkSettings` (PDF Watermark): Free tier watermark overlay settings.
5. **Security & Health**:
   - `integrationsSettings` (Maps & API Keys): Google Maps API key (for geocoding candidate jobs), reCAPTCHA v3.
   - `securityLimitsSettings` (Security & Limits): Rate limits, upload size caps, session expiration (SuperAdmin only).
   - `systemHealthSettings` (System Health): Live diagnostics, maintenance mode toggle, service reachability (SuperAdmin only).
   - `featureFlagsSettings` (Feature Flags): Dynamic feature gates and canary rollout flags (SuperAdmin only).
   - `platformConfigSettings` (Platform Config): Node environment, worker clusters, secrets census (SuperAdmin only).
   - `codeInjectionSettings` (Code Injection): Header/Footer script injection with sanitization (SuperAdmin only).
   - `gdprLegalSettings` (GDPR & Legal Compliance): Cookie consent banner, privacy policy, user data purge controls.
6. **Content & Media**:
   - `templateManagerSettings` (Templates Manager): 51 Resume + 4 Cover Letter templates activation & ordering.
   - `pages` (Pages & CMS): Static CMS pages (About, Terms, Privacy, FAQ).
   - `blog` (Blog Engine): Career advice blog posts, categories, tags.
   - `socialSettings` (Social Channels): Official corporate social media links.
   - `analytics` (Analytics & Tracking): GA4 measurement ID, Facebook Pixel, clarity.
   - `ads` (Ads Manager): Google AdSense ad slots & placement controls.

## 3. Dual-Tier Multi-Tenant Fallback Architecture
For settings configured at the platform level that organizations can optionally override (AI Providers, Storage, Email/SMTP, Branding, Currency):
- The platform maintains an authoritative two-tier resolution:
  - **Tier 1 (SuperAdmin Master Fallback)**: The global configuration saved here powers the candidate portal, public jobs board, unconfigured organizations, and background services.
  - **Tier 2 (Organization Custom Override)**: In `/org/:slug/settings`, tenant organizations can supply their own BYOK AI keys, dedicated SMTP, custom S3 buckets, and white-label branding. If unconfigured or empty, the backend automatically and securely falls back to Tier 1.
- In `Settings.jsx`, render a clear Google-styled dual-tier info banner on these panels informing SuperAdmins of their fallback status.

## 4. Google-Inspired 2-Pane Control Center Layout
- **Omnibox Search Bar**: Sticky top bar with instant client-side filtering across all 30 settings by title, group, or keyword.
- **Left Navigation Rail / Tree**: Grouped accordion with icons, item count badges, active indicators, and category expand/collapse.
- **Right Configuration Viewport**: Clean header, breadcrumbs, dual-tier fallback banner, and the isolated setting component.
- **Responsive Drawer**: On mobile (<1024px), provide an accessible slide-over drawer with backdrop blur.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).

INV-2: Zero Token & Secret Leakage: API keys (Gemini, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Twilio, Stripe, Razorpay) must never be displayed in plain text in client DOM or logs; post-save masking and server vault protection enforced.

INV-3: SuperAdmin RBAC Integrity: Sensitive panels (Firebase, Database, Social Auth, AI, Storage, Security Limits, Platform Config, Code Injection, Feature Flags) must strictly require isSuperAdmin === true; unauthorized operator sessions must be denied with HTTP 403 / rendered refusal.

INV-4: Authentic MariaDB Grounding: All settings must read and persist exclusively to authoritative MariaDB system_settings table via getAdminSystemSettings / saveSystemSettings with ZERO synthetic mocks.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Sub-100ms tab switching latency; production bundle build duration < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Google-Inspired 2-Pane Control Center Architecture: Redesign src/components/admin/settings/Settings.jsx with a Google Cloud / Google Workspace Admin inspired layout featuring: (a) Left-hand sticky Navigation Tree / Category Drawer showing all 6 groups and 30 settings with active badges; (b) Real-time instant search/filter bar to jump to any setting by name/keyword; (c) Right-hand elevated Cuba M3 workspace rendering the active setting panel.

AC-2: Full 30-Setting Accessibility Restoration: Wire all 30 settings components (Modules, Website, Branding, Indian Geo-SEO, LLM Geo, Firebase, Database, Social Auth, Email SMTP, Cloud Storage, AI Providers, PDF Exporter, Job Scraper, Twilio SMS, Currency, Orders, Subscriptions, Watermark, Integrations, Security Limits, System Health, Feature Flags, Platform Config, Code Injection, GDPR, Template Manager, Pages, Blog, Social Links, Analytics, Ads) so every panel is 100% accessible and deep-linkable via ?tab=<key>.

AC-3: Dual-Tier Multi-Tenant Fallback Architecture & Informative Banners: For settings that can be customized at the organization level (AI Providers, Storage, Email/SMTP, Branding, Currency), render an authoritative Google-styled banner explaining: 'Global Master & Organization Fallback Engine: Configurations set here act as platform-wide defaults. Tenant organizations without custom BYO credentials automatically inherit these master settings.'

AC-4: Command Palette & Cuba Portal Navigation Integration: Update src/components/cuba/portalNavigation.js to expose the top-level settings categories in ADMIN_PORTAL_NAVIGATION and the Cuba command palette (Ctrl+K) so operators and SuperAdmins can search and deep-link directly into any setting.
AC-5: Mobile & Tablet Responsiveness: Responsive collapsible navigation drawer on mobile/tablet screens (<1024px) with smooth slide-over drawer and touch-friendly controls.

AC-6: Google M3 & Cuba Executive Design System Harmonization: Replace all legacy Tailwind classes (bg-slate-50, border-slate-200, text-indigo-600) with semantic Cuba tokens (--cuba-canvas, --cuba-card, --cuba-elevated, --cuba-line, --cuba-ink, --cuba-ink-muted, .cuba-btn-primary, .cuba-btn-outline, .cuba-fill-pill) with flawless dark mode support.

AC-7: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir015.config.js & tests/e2e/dir015-superadmin-settings.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying: (a) navigation tree rendering all 6 groups and 30 settings; (b) search filter dynamic narrowing; (c) tab switching and deep-linking via URL search params; (d) dual-tier fallback banners; (e) MariaDB persistence round-trip; (f) zero console/API defects.
AC-8: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

plan.summary: DIR-015 PLAN (no code changed). BASELINE GREEN: vite build 3.57s (<4.0s budget); frozen diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates backend/services/aiRuntime.js = 0 lines; cuba-admin-console+cuba-design-system 49/49. ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: Cuba is the DEFAULT shell (cubaShellFlag), legacy sidebar unmounted, and Settings.jsx has ZERO internal navigation - it only reads ?tab= via useSearchParams, so every panel is unreachable. PLAN: (1) NEW authoritative settings catalog module exporting SETTINGS_GROUPS (6 groups, 31 canonical panels) + 2 legacy alias keys (facebookAuthSettings->SocialAuthSettings, paymentSettings->subscriptionsSettings) = 33 deep-linkable tabs; single source consumed by BOTH the control center and the palette so they can never drift. (2) Rewrite Settings.jsx as 2-pane Google-style Control Center: sticky omnibox + left accordion nav tree (icons, count badges, aria-current) + right CubaCard workspace; reuse CubaPageHeader primitives, CubaDrawer for <1024px, CubaBadge/CubaButton, and the shared useDialogA11y contract. (3) Preserve the existing wrapper RBAC denial verbatim (superAdminOnly + permission gate) and extend the SAME predicate to the nav tree so a denied panel is visibly locked, never silently missing. (4) AC-3 dual-tier banners on the 5 named panels, copy verified against real backend routes. (5) AC-4: expose the 6 category groups in a NEW ADMIN_SETTINGS_NAVIGATION export merged into the Ctrl+K palette (NOT into ADMIN_PORTAL_NAVIGATION - see blocker B2). (6) NEW playwright.dir015.config.js + tests/e2e/dir015-superadmin-settings.spec.js with 8 stages incl. MariaDB round-trip; npm run test:dir015 script. (7) Gates: build<4s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions, frozen diff 0.
steps: 1. Add settingsCatalog.js: 6 groups / 31 canonical panels + 2 aliases, permissions, dualTier flag, icons, keywords
2. Rewrite Settings.jsx as 2-pane control center: omnibox search (reuse fuzzyRank), sticky accordion nav tree with count badges + aria-current, right CubaCard workspace, deep-link via ?tab= preserved
3. Extend the existing RBAC predicate to the nav tree so denied panels render visibly locked
keep the refusal card byte-identical in behaviour
4. Add the dual-tier fallback banner to the 5 AC-3 panels, text grounded in verified backend routes
5. Add ADMIN_SETTINGS_NAVIGATION to portalNavigation.js and merge into the Ctrl+K palette
keep ADMIN_PORTAL_NAVIGATION untouched so the DIR-012 PATH_PERMS parity test stays green
6. Mobile <1024px: reuse CubaDrawer (focus trap, Escape, focus restore, backdrop) for the nav tree

7. Token harmonisation: replace every bg-slate-*/border-slate-*/text-indigo-* in Settings.jsx with --cuba-* Tailwind utilities (bg-cuba-card, border-cuba-line, text-cuba-ink-muted) so dark mode is free via the existing [data-theme=dark] republish
8. Add playwright.dir015.config.js + tests/e2e/dir015-superadmin-settings.spec.js (8 stages) + npm run test:dir015
9. Gates: vite build <4s, eslint 0 errors, npm test 0 regressions, frozen diff 0 bytes, then submit evidence to Gatekeeper

reviews.feedback:
Senior Engineering Lead Review: PLAN APPROVED.

1. Architecture & Decomposition:
   - Creating a single source of truth `settingsCatalog.js` (6 groups, 31 canonical panels + 2 legacy aliases) consumed by both Settings.jsx and the Ctrl+K command palette is exemplary systems design.
   - The 2-pane Google Cloud-inspired layout (omnibox search, sticky accordion tree with badges, right CubaCard workspace, CubaDrawer on mobile) satisfies AC-1, AC-2, and AC-5.

2. Blocker Resolutions Confirmed:
   - B1: Backend :8080 is verified UP and healthy on /api/health with MariaDB UP/NORMAL.
   - B2: Exporting `ADMIN_SETTINGS_NAVIGATION` for Command Palette merging while leaving `ADMIN_PORTAL_NAVIGATION` untouched is approved.
   - A3: 31 canonical panels + 2 deep-linkable aliases (33 total reachable tab keys) is approved.
   - A4: Truthful per-panel copy grounded in actual wired backend routes is approved.

3. System Invariants:
   - Invariant INV-1 strictly enforced (git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js == 0 bytes).
   - Vite build < 4.0s, ESLint 0 errors, Playwright E2E with real MariaDB round-trip.
